|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 4) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current text; the current text is [[Imperial Enforcement (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints “E”, but this is the original printing; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 12 July 2020<ref name="img-iefdfe14b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/imperialenforcement.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/fdfe14b7f81967a10e659a872abdeebecd8c5a25 commit fdfe14b] (12 July 2020); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Dark/large/imperialenforcement.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). Unless you occupy fewer locations than opponent: if you win a battle, retrieve an Imperial; and, during battle, may take an Imperial just drawn for destiny into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. [Immune to Alter.]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Imperial Enforcement (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 3 October 2022<ref name="img-ieca1ccff">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/imperialenforcement.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ca1ccff62ff30b7e29da803f91a6d09ab542d803 commit ca1ccff] (3 October 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Dark/large/imperialenforcement.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the PC re-made the image at higher resolution and the errata mark now prints “E1” (the 2020 image printed “E”); words unchanged. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”. Text: “Deploy on table. Lost if your non-Imperial character (or starship) on table. Unless you occupy fewer locations than opponent: if you win a battle, retrieve an Imperial; and, during battle, may take an Imperial just drawn for destiny into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. [Immune to Alter.]”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Imperial Enforcement (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 12 December 2022<ref name="img-ie12d0bca">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/imperialenforcement.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c commit 12d0bca] (12 December 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Dark/large/imperialenforcement.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' rewritten: “Lost if your non-Imperial character (or starship) on table” → “Canceled if …” at the end; adds “You may initiate battles for free”; the occupy-fewer-locations clause and Imperial retrieval removed; the redraw now works once per turn on any character just drawn for destiny. (Holotable card data shows this text from 12–13 December 2022 and still shows it today.) Document: errata mark “E2”. Text: “Deploy on table. You may initiate battles for free. Once per turn, if you just drew a character for destiny, may take that card into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. Canceled if your non-Imperial character (or starship) on table. [Immune to Alter.]”
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Imperial Enforcement (Errata 3)]]): PC card image uploaded 20 December 2022<ref name="img-ie212764a">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/imperialenforcement.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/212764ae96d81cc777c715508bde1c6984638051 commit 212764a] (20 December 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Dark/large/imperialenforcement.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' “Once per turn, if you just drew a character for destiny” → “Once per turn during battle, if you just drew a character for destiny”. It is the current image (same file as the wiki's existing image and res.starwarsccg.org today). The PC's card data (Holotable, swccg-card-json) was never updated to “during battle” and still has the PC-E2 words. Document: errata mark “E3”. Text: “Deploy on table. You may initiate battles for free. Once per turn during battle, if you just drew a character for destiny, may take that card into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. Canceled if your non-Imperial character (or starship) on table. [Immune to Alter.]”
